core_obligations: Torsion case: reduce to open immersions and proper morphisms by construction; for an open immersion j_! is exact so N = 0; for proper f use Rf_! = Rf_* with negative vanishing for the left bound and the bounded cohomological dimension of f_*, concluding via the unbounded right derived functor lemma (proof lines 3810-3825).
Arbitrary Lambda: on D^+_tors reduce again to proper f with Rf_! = Rf_*; part (1) is immediate from the right derived functor property (proof lines 3828-3831).

Parts (3) and (2): induct on b - a using the distinguished triangles of truncations together with the proper cohomological dimension lemma for part (3); part (2) follows from the vanishing range of part (3) (proof lines 3831-3835).
